description: Search Citilink.ru, browse a category, or fetch full product details.

brands.description: Keep only these brands, case-insensitive (e.g. `XIAOMI`, `Samsung`). Records without a brand are dropped when this filter is set. Applies to search and byCategory modes.
brands.title: Brands (optional)

category.description: A Citilink category slug (`smartfony`), a nested catalog compilation (`smartfony/iphone`), a path (`/catalog/smartfony/`), or a full URL (`https://www.citilink.ru/catalog/smartfony/iphone/`). Find paths by browsing citilink.ru/catalog/.
category.title: Category or compilation (mode=byCategory)

inStockOnly.description: Only emit products currently available for purchase.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The live catalog exposes up to its own result count; very broad categories can be much larger than this cap.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this (Russian rubles).
maxPrice.title: Max price (RUB)

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Cap on full-text customer reviews fetched per product ID (mode=reviews). Distinct from the star-rating opinion summary already included in mode=productDetails.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product (mode=reviews)

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this (Russian rubles).
minPrice.title: Min price (RUB)

minRating.description: Drop products rated below this (0-5 scale).
minRating.title: Min rating

enumTitles: Fetch product details by ID or URL
Fetch full customer reviews by product ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

monitorMode.description: Compare this run with the previous run of the same search/category and add changeType, previousPrice, priceChangePercent, firstSeenAt, and lastSeenAt to each product. State is kept in the actor's key-value store. Off by default.
monitorMode.title: Price & stock monitor

onlyChanges.description: When monitorMode is on, emit only products that are new or whose price/availability changed since the previous run. Has no effect when monitorMode is off.
onlyChanges.title: Only changed products (monitor mode)

productIds.description: Citilink product IDs (e.g. `2143346`) or full product URLs (e.g. `https://www.citilink.ru/product/smartfon-apple-iphone-17-a3520-256gb-purpurnyi-3g-4g-1sim-6-3-1206x262-2143346/`).
productIds.title: Product IDs or URLs (mode=productDetails / mode=reviews)

proxyConfiguration.description: Citilink is protected by the QRATOR anti-bot service, which requires a real browser session. The default AUTO (datacenter) proxy group works for this challenge; residential proxy is not required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search (mode=search). A query that exactly matches a Citilink category (e.g. `ноутбук`) opens that category's full catalog page; other queries use the site search. Examples: `iphone`, `ноутбук`, `телевизор`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result order (search/byCategory). Applied server-side by Citilink; the actor verifies the order before emitting.
sortBy.title: Sort by

watchId.description: Reuse the same monitor history across several differently-configured runs (e.g. one task for several queries). Leave empty to derive a stable ID from the mode, query/category, sort, brands, and maxItems.
watchId.title: Monitor watch ID (optional)

title: Citilink Scraper Input
